articles.title: Pentagon Pete’s Embarrassing New Boat Strike Blunder Exposed
articles.summary: Pete Hegseth's 'bomb-first, question-later' strategy against alleged narcoterrorists is reportedly proving counterproductive, allowing targets to evade justice. This aggressive approach, exemplified by a bombing on a suspected drug-carrying boat, highlights concerns regarding the efficacy and legal repercussions of such military tactics. The strategy appears to undermine efforts to prosecute suspected criminals, raising questions about operational procedures and international law.

articles.title: Wisconsin winter weather: Snow returns Sunday night into Monday
articles.summary: A winter weather advisory has been issued for Dodge, Washington, Ozaukee, Fond du Lac, and Sheboygan Counties in the United States. The advisory is effective from 6 p.m. Sunday, December 28, to 12 p.m. Monday, December 29. Residents in these central and northern regions are advised to prepare for potential adverse weather conditions and exercise caution during this period.
